name: bridge network mode (EC2 default)
description: Containers attached to the host's docker0 bridge. Each container gets a private IP within the bridge subnet. Inbound exposed via per-container hostPort (static or ephemeral 0). Multiple tasks of the same family on one instance need different hostPorts. Default for EC2 launch type.

name: host network mode
description: Container shares the host's network namespace — uses host IP directly, no port translation. Highest perf (no veth-bridge hop). DOWNSIDE: only one task per containerPort per host (port conflicts if 2+ tasks try same port). Forbidden on Fargate.

name: awsvpc network mode
description: Per-task ENI (Elastic Network Interface) with own IP, own security group(s), own routing. Required for Fargate. Recommended for EC2 in production. Enables: per-task IAM credentials over 169.254.170.2 endpoint, per-task SG isolation, full VPC integration. Limited by per-instance ENI quota — see HDE/trunking for relief.

name: none network mode
description: No networking at all. Loopback only inside container. Used for batch jobs that don't need network (data-processing reading from a mounted volume).

name: ENI trunking (HDE — High Density ENI)
description: Bypasses the per-instance ENI quota by attaching a 'trunk' ENI that sub-divides into 'branch' ENIs (one per awsvpc task). Increases task density 5-20x depending on instance type. Requires: Nitro instance + IAM perm (ec2:CreateNetworkInterfacePermission) + ECS_ENABLE_HIGH_DENSITY_ENI=true + AwsvpcTrunking opt-in via PutAccountSetting.

name: Task ENI attach/detach flow
description: Per-task ENI lifecycle: 1) ECS service requests EC2 to attach an ENI to the instance. 2) Agent's CNI plugins move the ENI into the task's network namespace. 3) Routes + IP configured. 4) On task stop, agent unmounts; ECS detaches. Failures here surface as 'CannotCreateContainerError: failed to setup task network'.

name: Task credentials endpoint (169.254.170.2)
description: Link-local IP that resolves to the agent on every task instance. Serves task-IAM-role credentials at $AWS_CONTAINER_CREDENTIALS_RELATIVE_URI. AWS SDKs auto-discover this. Only works on awsvpc + select bridge configurations; host mode requires ECS_ENABLE_TASK_IAM_ROLE_NETWORK_HOST + iptables setup.

name: Task Metadata Endpoint (TMDS) v3/v4
description: Per-container HTTP endpoint serving task + container metadata + container stats. Path injected as $ECS_CONTAINER_METADATA_URI (v3) and $ECS_CONTAINER_METADATA_URI_V4 (v4). v4 adds /task/stats endpoint with cgroup-derived metrics. Use this from inside containers — avoid the agent's port 51678 (host-only) and the EC2 IMDS (different scope).

name: Per-task Security Groups
description: awsvpc mode lets each task have its own SG(s) — separate from the instance's SG. Enables fine-grained network policy per workload (e.g., db-client tasks allowed to reach RDS, log-shipper tasks blocked from RDS). Configured at run-task / service-create time via networkConfiguration.awsvpcConfiguration.securityGroups[].

name: assignPublicIp toggle
description: awsvpc tasks in public subnets can get a public IP (assignPublicIp=ENABLED) or stay private (DISABLED). Required ENABLED for tasks pulling from public-internet-only registries when no NAT is available. Default DISABLED.

name: ECS Service Connect
description: AWS-managed service-mesh layer (Envoy-based) that gives services DNS-discoverable names + automatic mTLS + telemetry. Replaces older Service Discovery (Cloud Map alone). Requires per-task sidecar; works with awsvpc mode. Cluster-level configuration.

name: Service Discovery (AWS Cloud Map)
description: Older service-discovery: ECS registers task IPs in a Cloud Map namespace (private DNS namespace in Route 53). Other services DNS-resolve <service>.<namespace>. Service Connect supersedes for new clusters but Cloud Map still useful for cross-service-type discovery (Lambda + ECS + EC2).
